name: Seoul style
status: draft for stage 1 (2026-11-25): values match seoul/index.html; the spec, prompt and generated files come in stage 2
touchpoints: what Seoul's city hall puts forward when it shows the city to its people: the Seoul colour of the year and Seoul Light (2026 Morning Yellow, the morning sun over Namsan, lit on City Hall, the bridges and the towers), the ten Seoul colours (Dancheong red, Hangang silver white, stone-wall grey, roof-tile charcoal and the rest), the emblem's mountain, sun and river after Jeong Seon's morning sun over Mongmyeok, Seoul Real-time City Data (121 places, four crowd levels, a four-step gauge with a pin, people as a range, 'now X is Normal'), and the Hangang park counts listed in river order

devices.river-band: Figure 1: the riverside parks laid along the river as the Hangang park counts list them. The river is a #d9ebf5 band across the card with white bridge ticks and West · East at its ends; each park sits at its km from the west end, north-bank bars up and south-bank bars down from the band, in stone grey #a6a39a with 4px rounded far ends. The plan is a dashed #8c877c outline with a 2px ink tick; only the park the title names is Morning Yellow #fa9800, with its value and change against plan under its name. The other bank fades to 28% under a bank filter
devices.crowd-gauge: Figure 2: places ranked by hours at Busy, each row with the real-time city data's four-step gauge (Calm · Normal · Slightly busy · Busy) filled up to the place's busiest level this week and an ink pin where its busiest hour fell. The busiest hour is written as a range in steps of 2,000 (1,000 under 10,000) with the day and hour; hours at Busy in the serif with ▲ ▼ against the last four weeks
devices.seoul-light-board: KPI row: four white boards with a 5px band on top in Hangang silver white; the one KPI the headline is about lights up in the Seoul colour of the year #fe9c00 (Seoul Light). The value in the serif at 44px with a small grey unit, a bar against plan or target (an hour-per-square strip for busy hours, the squares past the target in Dancheong red) and the change with ▲ ▼

korean-touches.obangsaek: the five colours read through the Seoul colours: yellow at the centre (Morning Yellow) for the lead, blue for the river, red (Dancheong) for crowds and shortfalls, white (Hangang silver white, hanji) for the ground, black (roof-tile charcoal, ink) for lines and text
korean-touches.ridges: Figure 3: the week as ink-wash ridges, Monday at the back and Sunday in front, each ridge outlined in roof-tile charcoal over a white halo; the level bands cut it across, so only the peaks turn red; a Morning Yellow sun sits on the busiest hour with its label in the sky above
korean-touches.jogakbo: Figure 4: places as a patchwork, area for visits, colour for the change on last week on a seven-step river-blue to Dancheong-red scale through Hangang silver white; places of one kind sit on one #e2dccf cloth with white seams and a white tag for the kind
korean-touches.calendar: Figure 5: a Korean wall calendar, Saturday blue and Sunday and holidays red, the solar terms and festive days written in the cell, only days over the entry-control line in Morning Yellow
korean-touches.seal: Table 1: the sign-off as a double-ruled seal: approved in Dancheong red, under review in charcoal, on hold dashed
korean-touches.serif: headline, company name, KPI values, section titles and day labels in a serif (Noto Serif · Noto Serif KR) in the manner of Seoul's own Hangang typeface, which the package does not load

sample.topic: City life weekly of Vizney City, a fictional river city split into Gangbuk (north bank) and Gangnam (south bank), week 48 (Nov 23–29, 2026) against week 47 and the October plan: visits to ten riverside parks along the river and fourteen bridges, people present by the hour at sixteen watched places against their room, the year-end light festival at two sites (Nov 20 to Jan 3, 5–10 pm) with its entry-control line, on-site staff (one per 500 people present once a place is Slightly busy) and the actions waiting for sign-off. Every place name and figure is invented

page.role: the page: hanji paper, a warm step lighter than Hangang silver white

line.role: 1px card outlines, the rule under the header, calendar cells, the patchwork cloth

hair.role: row rules, empty gauge steps, the track under KPI bars

ink.role: titles, values, the selected pill (white text), the plan tick, the gauge pin, section rules, focus (15.7:1 on the page)

muted.role: labels, subtitles, notes, axis text, units (5.7:1 on white, 5.2:1 on the page)

giwa.role: Seoul colour roof-tile charcoal: ridge outlines, KPI bars, ranks, term labels in the calendar, the seal under review

stone.role: Seoul colour stone-wall grey: the bars that are not the lead, the busy-hours bars in Table 1

silver.role: Seoul colour Hangang silver white: the KPI bands that are not lit, the middle of the change scale

tint.role: hovered rows, days before the festival

sun.role: Seoul colour of 2026 Morning Yellow (official sRGB 254/156/0), for UI only: the lit KPI band, the step numbers in the build section

sun-text.role: Morning Yellow as text: section numbers, the lead's value, the sun's label (5.14:1 on white)

river.role: the emblem's river blue (sRGB 0/121/188): good changes, the river scale

river-text.role: river blue as text: West · East on the band, Saturday (6.9:1 on white, 5.7:1 on the band)

red.role: Seoul symbol colour Dancheong red (sRGB 174/25/50): Busy, bad changes, Sunday and holidays, the approved seal (7.0:1 on white)

lead.role: the one thing a title names: the park, the KPI band, the lit days. #fe9c00 sits at L .776, just outside the light band, so data uses #fa9800 (L .764)

data.emblem: the three categorical hues are the emblem's sun, river and mountain (official river #0079bc and mountain #2e853c; the sun moved to Morning Yellow); 'other' is stone-wall grey

crowd.role: people present ÷ room, the four levels and words of Seoul Real-time City Data. Calm and Normal stay neutral, only the busy end is red; the city data's own colours are not used because its Slightly busy #ff7f00 sits ΔE 5.5 from Morning Yellow

status.role: a good change is river blue, a bad one Dancheong red, always with ▲ ▼ and a sign

text.role: values and labels stay in ink; changes blue when good and red when bad

validation.categorical: #fa9800 · #0079bc · #2e853c + #a6a39a on #ffffff, light, all pairs: separation passes (worst CVD ΔE 13.4 protan, normal 16.6, both between the sun and stone grey); grey is grey on purpose (chroma 0.013); #fa9800 2.2:1 and #a6a39a 2.5:1 on white, so the lead always carries a value label and every figure has a table view
validation.crowd: #f1ede6 · #bfb9ac · #d9727f · #ae1932: adjacent CVD 11.0, normal 16.1; the red pair passes --ordinal (6°, light end 3.15:1); Calm and Normal are neutral on purpose and always come with their words
validation.diverging: arms checked apart --ordinal: #86b8e0 · #3d8bc6 · #005e94 (1°, light end 2.11:1) and #e399a3 · #d9727f · #ae1932 (9°, light end 2.25:1) pass; midpoint Hangang silver white #e0dfde (CVD 13.6 to the blue arm)
validation.text: on white: ink 17.2, body 14.6, muted 5.7, charcoal 8.3, sun text 5.1, river text 6.9, red 7.0; on the page: muted 5.2, sun text 4.7; on the band: river text 5.7; on Morning Yellow days: ink 8.2, Saturday #003f66 5.0, Sunday #7a0d21 5.0

sans.role: body, labels and numbers, one face per language: seoul.go.kr sets Korean in Pretendard Variable and english.seoul.go.kr sets English in Noto Sans. Numbers tabular

serif.role: display only: the headline, the company name, KPI values, hours at Busy, ranks, section titles and numbers, day labels; in the manner of Seoul's own serif (Seoul Hangang)

typography.city-fonts: Seoul's own typefaces (Seoul Hangang, Seoul Namsan) are free to use but not to sell or redistribute, so the sample and the package do not load them as web fonts. A company that installs them on its own machines can set them in Tableau and Power BI

scale.headline: serif 30px/600 (ko 29px), line-height 1.3; 23px under 640px; crowd words inside it as pills (.74em/700)
scale.action: 16px/500 under the headline, the arrow and the numbers in 700
scale.card-title: 19px/700 (ko 18.5px), the figure number above it 12.5px/700 muted
scale.kpi: label 14px/700; value serif 44px/600 tabular (38px under 1200px, 30px under 640px), unit 17px/600 muted; change 14px
scale.section: number serif 15px/700 in sun text, title serif 24px/600
scale.figures: names 12.5px/600 (the lead 700), the lead's value 12.5px/700 sun text; calendar values 15px/700, dates 11.5px/600, terms 10.5px/600
scale.gauge-list: rank serif 17px/600, name 14.5px/700, range 14px/700, hours at Busy serif 19px/600

rows: header 60px on hanji with a 1px #e2dccf rule: Vizney City in the serif, the report name, the EN/KO switch
Week 48 · Nov 23–29, 2026 · the first week after Soseol, with the bank filter on the right (All · Gangbuk · Gangnam pills)
the result in the city data's voice with the crowd words as pills, and the action under it
KPI row: four Seoul Light boards (riverside park visits, busy hours, festival visits, staff coverage)
first screen (1440×810): Figure 1, the river band | Figure 2, the crowd gauges (520px). Bottoms on one line
01 Where and when people gathered: Figure 3, the week as ridges | Figure 4, the patchwork
02 The festival and the actions: Figure 5, the calendar | Table 1, actions and seals (six rows and the rest on demand)
03 Build it yourself · 04 How we count (ten definitions) · footer
layout.responsive: 1360 and over: Figure 2 at 520px; 1200–1359: 480px; 1024–1199: 440px, place kinds and the table's bars drop out. Under 1024: Figures and rows stack, KPI 2×2. Under 640: one column, the bank filter in three equal pills, the gauge list drops the busiest-hour column, calendar values move to the cell's corner

motion.bars: 0.55s, Figure 1's bars grow out of the river, 35ms apart
motion.ridges: 0.6s, the ridges rise from their baselines, Monday first, 70ms apart; the sun fades in after

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Noto Sans, Pretendard or the Seoul typefaces only if installed on every viewing machine and the server

measured.seoul-colours: seoul.go.kr/seoul/color.do (updated 2026-02-25): 2026 Morning Yellow sRGB 254/156/0 (#fe9c00), lighting RGB 255/72/0, 'the morning sun over Namsan'; 2025 Green Aurora #00b493; 2024 Sky Coral #f8496c. Seoul Light on City Hall, DDP, Seoul Tower, the bridges. Ten Seoul colours from seoul_color_10.pdf in sRGB: Dancheong red #ae1932, Hangang silver white #e0dfde, flower-wall ochre #d16f15, Seoul sky #558bcf, Namsan green #345f53, palace brown #5f4541, roof-tile charcoal #504e48, stone-wall grey #a6a39a, ginkgo yellow #f6b65a, hemp beige #dcccac (the PDF's web hex values are Adobe RGB and are not used). Citizens may use the Seoul colours for events, facilities, spaces and products
measured.emblem: seoul.go.kr/seoul/emblem.do: the word Seoul drawn as mountain (green), sun (centre) and river (blue), after Jeong Seon's morning sun over Mongmyeok; exclusive colours Dancheong red, blue sRGB 0/121/188 (#0079bc), green sRGB 46/133/60 (#2e853c). The emblem itself is not used
measured.real-time-city-data: data.seoul.go.kr/SeoulRtd: 121 places; crowd levels Calm · Normal · Slightly busy · Busy (여유 · 보통 · 약간 붐빔 · 붐빔) in #00884e · #ffd001 · #ff7f00 · #dd1f3d; 'now [place] is' (now 20px/500 #abb1c1, place 22px/700 #4c65a7); people as a range '48,000~50,000' 24px/700 #393f49 with a 16px #aeaeae unit; a four-step gauge with a pin and the word under it; ▲ ▼ against an hour and three hours ago and the 28-day average of the same weekday and hour; hourly bars coloured by level; ground #e7edf5, Noto Sans KR
measured.hangang-parks: hangang.seoul.go.kr/www/utztnStatsNew: eleven parks in river order with total, daily average, residents, visitors, foreigners and cyclists; the Hangang park identity is a band running east to west
measured.seoul-day: data.seoul.go.kr/dataVisual/seoul/seoulList.do: a day of Seoul as number tiles, a big number with a small unit
measured.seoul.go.kr: Pretendard Variable 16px body; text #222222, second #616b7e, lines #dedede, dark surface #363743; section titles 40px/700; corners 20px and 30px, pill search box; the 'good' air pill #0d6efd
measured.not-used: SEOUL MY SOUL (pink #ff0a73, yellow #fabf13, blue #0082ff, green #00d778, the heart · ! · smile pictograms): needs an application and the slogan combinations are the city's own. The emblem, logos, slogan, mascot (Haechi), landmark pictograms and photos are not used

notice.en: Not an official design of the Seoul Metropolitan Government, and not affiliated with or endorsed by it. A reference style read from the publicly visible design of its website (seoul.go.kr) and public touchpoints such as the Seoul colours, Seoul Light and Seoul Real-time City Data; it carries no logo, typeface, photo or data of theirs. Trademarks belong to their owners.
notice.ko: 서울특별시의 공식 디자인이 아니며 제휴·승인 관계가 없습니다. 공개된 웹사이트(seoul.go.kr)와 서울색·서울빛·서울 실시간 도시데이터 등 공개된 접점에서 보이는 디자인을 읽어 낸 참고용 스타일이며 로고·서체·사진·데이터는 포함하지 않습니다. 상표는 각 소유자의 것입니다.
notice.why: No naming guideline or set notice was found for describing the city by name; the Seoul colours are offered for citizens' use. The emblem, logos, the SEOUL MY SOUL brand, the mascot, landmark pictograms (KOGL type 4), real place names and figures, and photos are not used
